_note: Per-venue requirements a card is judged against (2026-11-03). Each check: id, kind, and min or max.
kinds: depth (band = % from mid; side each | combined), spread (top of book, % of mid), volume (24 h quote),
levels (book levels per side; band = within % of mid, omitted = the whole returned book; agg avg | min),
drop (largest peak-to-trough fall inside any window_h, % of the peak), price_diff (mid vs the median of the
coin's other collected venues, %). A rep can change min/max or switch a check off for one audit (bot.py).
Rules public data cannot test (self-trading, taker-only volume, trade frequency, multichain value, listing
terms) are left off on purpose. Binance and OKX have no published rules here: 5x and 3x the average of the
Averages: (per-side +-2% depth 3,425; spread 1.078%, divided, since lower is stricter; 24 h volume
28,333 from BingX 30k, Bybit 50k, MEXC 5k). HTX publishes none either: 1x those averages, rounded
KuCoin, Bitget, Gate and Kraken publish no volume rule; they get that 28,333 average as a house 24 h volume minimum (2026-11-03).
Bybit (taker volume, aim 50k) and MEXC (non-self-trading volume, 5k) are checked against total 24 h volume: a fail is a real fail, a pass is an upper estimate (2026-11-03).
Every venue carries the same three checks, so every card shows the same four tiles (depth2, spread, vol, then
Liquidity Trend), 2026-11-10. Dropped for that: Bitget's +-10% depth, order levels, 24 h / 3-day price
drop and price vs other exchanges, BingX's order levels, Kraken's +-0.25% and +-1% depth. Kraken publishes no
spread rule: 1x the average, rounded, 1% (as HTX). The other kinds still work if a venue is given one.
